_meta.note: Wiki-harvested seed shard. `Elemental Absorption` names a different set of elements on different items: the {{Absorption|Elemental|N}} template takes a third parameter deciding whether Sonic is included, and the distinction lives in the RENDERED TOOLTIP, not the visible cell -- which reads `Elemental Absorption +N%` either way. gear-planner stores nothing that distinguishes them, so the flag has to be sourced per item. Only `stated` is solver-eligible; an entry that is absent or non-stated is quarantined rather than defaulted in either direction, because a four-way expansion under-credits a Sonic carrier and a five-way over-credits the rest. See docs/wiki-evidence/compound-absorption.md. Every entry carries a per-item verbatim `tooltip` read from that item's own rendered page: it is the ONLY witness independent of `raw`, because the shared `snapshots` block is keyed BY the invocation, so a snapshot can never disagree with the invocation that selected it. A guard resting on the snapshot alone goes green on an entry whose value and cited source are wrong together.
